deadline.value: Graduate applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, with no set deadline.
deadline.quote: For Clarkson University's programs, there are no set deadlines for graduate admissions. Instead, we review applications on a rolling basis.

gre_general.value: The GRE is optional; applicants are advised to submit scores if they will help.
gre_general.quote: Optional: Applications will be read without GRE test scores, but applicants should submit scores if they believe they will enhance their application.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty agreement is needed before admission.

funding.value: Only a limited number of tuition scholarships and stipends are offered, mostly tied to assistantships or an MS thesis.
funding.quote: A limited number of one-year and partial-year tuition scholarships are available for qualified full-time students.

also.quote: Most scholarships and/or stipends are associated with department assistantships or completion of a master’s thesis as part of the qualified applicant’s plan of study.

entry_route.value: The page does not say which prior degree is required.

notes: Umbrella program run through the Coulter School of Engineering and Applied Sciences; the same online application applies.
